newsitem.title: JAPAN: NTT consortium sues India telecom ministry.
newsitem.headline: NTT consortium sues India telecom ministry.

text.p: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT) said on Thursday that a consortium of which it is a member had filed a lawsuit in India against that country's telecommunications ministry over a contract to provide telecom services.
Despite the suit, NTT hopes to proceed with the project, a spokesman for NTT said.
The consortium comprises the RPG group of India, Itochu Corp and NTT, he said.
In March, the ministry granted permits to the group to start telecommunications services in India's southern state of Tamil Nadu, the NTT spokesman said.
The consortium was discussing details of the contract with the ministry and seeking a formal agreement, he said.

Initially, the ministry requested that the consortium pay the cost of installing facilities, but just before the formal signing on October 18, it demanded that the group also pay for the costs of maintenance, the NTT spokesman said.
After the consortium rejected the request, the ministry told the group on October 30 that it would seize the group's deposit for the project.
The consortium filed the lawsuit in New Delhi on October 31, the NTT spokesman said.
"We definitely want the project but we would like to draw better conditions in order to sign the formal agreement," the NTT spokesman said.
